2608.12282.title: VAKRA: Evaluating Multi-Hop Reasoning Across APIs and Retrieval Under Tool-Use Policies
2608.12282.paper_summary: Agents deployed in enterprise settings must reason across structured APIs and document collections, yet existing benchmarks evaluate these capabilities in isolation. We introduce VAKRA (e\textbf{V}aluating \textbf{A}PI and \textbf{K}nowledge \textbf{R}etrieval \textbf{A}gents), a benchmark of over $8{,}000$ executable APIs across $62$ domains with tasks spanning three settings of increasing difficulty: diverse API interaction styles, multi-hop reasoning over structured APIs, and multi-source reasoning with natural-language tool-use policy constraints. Correctness is verified by re-executing predicted tool calls against live APIs, accommodating multiple valid paths. Using a fixed ReAct harness to isolate model capabilities from agent architecture, we evaluate frontier and open-weight models and find that even the best model achieves only 70.4\% on single-hop endpoint-style tasks and drops to 50--51\% on compositional APIs; performance degrades by over 50\% as reasoning depth increases, and policy-constrained questions expose severe failures (as low as 2.4\% on unanswerable queries). Trace analysis shows failures concentrate at language-mediated reasoning - entity disambiguation, cross-source grounding, rather than tool invocation mechanics. Code is available https://github.com/IBM/VAKRA. Dataset is available https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-research/VAKRA
2608.12282.paper_summary_zh: 在企業環境中部署的代理必須在結構化 API 和文檔集合之間進行推理，但現有基準測試是孤立地評估這些能力。我們介紹了 VAKRA（e\textbf{V}aluating \textbf{A}PI 和 \textbf{K}nowledge \textbf{R}etrieval \textbf{A}gents），這是一個涵蓋超過 $8{,}000$ 個可執行 API 的基準，涉及 $62$ 個領域，任務跨越三個難度逐漸增加的設置：多樣的 API 交互風格、在結構化 API 上的多跳推理，以及具有自然語言工具使用政策約束的多來源推理。通過重新執行預測的工具調用來驗證正確性，並針對實時 API 考慮多條有效路徑。使用固定的 ReAct 體系來將模型能力與代理架構隔離，我們評估了前沿和開放權重模型，發現即使是最佳模型在單跳端點風格任務中也僅達到 70.4\%，在組合 API 中下降到 50--51\%；隨著推理深度的增加，性能下降超過 50\%，而政策約束問題則暴露出嚴重的失敗（在無法回答的查詢中低至 2.4\%）。跟蹤分析顯示失敗集中在語言介導的推理——實體消歧、跨來源基準，而不是工具調用機制。代碼可在 https://github.com/IBM/VAKRA 獲得。數據集可在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-research/VAKRA 獲得。
